title: Change capacity or switch monthly and yearly billing
summary: Review when a change takes effect and what is due before confirming it.

sections.title: Review a change
sections.body:
1. Open **Subscription & billing → Plan**.
2. Change **Locations**, **Bookable staff** or **Billing cycle**.
3. If shown, select **Review a switch to current pricing at renewal** only if you want to review moving from retained rates to current pricing.
4. Select **Review subscription**.
5. Read **Due today**, the recurring total, included credits and effective date.
6. Select **Confirm billing change**, or **Continue to secure checkout** when the review asks for payment.
7. Return to billing and verify the applied or scheduled state.

sections.title: When changes apply
sections.body: Expansion requires verified payment before extra capacity becomes available. Decreases and billing-cycle changes take effect at renewal. Existing paid terms stay in place until a reviewed change is explicitly confirmed. Your records are not removed to fit a smaller subscription.

sections.title: Before reducing capacity
sections.body: Check active location and staff usage first. If usage is above the requested capacity, safely review future bookings and deactivate only the records that should stop taking new work. Disabling a login alone does not make an active bookable profile inactive.

sections.title: If another change is pending
sections.body: An unfinished checkout or scheduled change can block another confirmation. Read the existing selection and status. Use the provided recovery actions; changing the visible estimate does not change a submitted payment request.
